L113: ## Features
L114: 
L115:  ■Packed with fun accessories!
L116: The NEOGEO Arcade Stick Pro Christmas Edition comes included with a NEOGEO mini PAD, a silicone cover, and other fun accessories! Note, the color of each accessory is random.
L117: ■Includes 40 super-popular NEOGEO games!
L118: This special version comes pre-loaded with all 20 of the previously hidden games. Now you can choose from a fantastic list of 40 games including many fighters and action platformers! The MVS version allows for extra credits, so no more game overs!
L119: ■Comes with a special NEOGEO 30^{th} Anniversary Album!
L120: The included album dives deep into the rich 30-year history of the NEOGEO franchise. It’s chock-full of advertisements in the heyday of NEOGEO hype surrounding your favorite games, as well as a space to write down whatever thoughts you may have while taking a trip down memory lane. The NEOGEO 30th Anniversary Album is only available when purchasing the Special Christmas Edition of the NEOGEO Arcade Stick Pro, so don’t miss out!
L121: 
L122: 【35†Image】
L123: [About the NEOGEO]
L124: Back in 1990, SNK launched two video game systems nearly simultaneously—The NEOGEO Multi-Video System (MVS) and the NEOGEO Advanced Entertainment System (AES). The NEOGEO MVS was a unique arcade system that allowed multiple NEOGEO cartridges to be inserted and played with just one cabinet. The NEOGEO AES on the other hand was a home console that delivered owners the exact same arcade-experience the MVS offered except right in the comfort of their living rooms!
L125: In 1994, SNK would release a game that was the culmination of many famous SNK titles coming together to fight in a series known as—THE KING OF FIGHTERS. That same year, SNK released a CD console called NEOGEO CD. 1998 saw the birth of the NEOGEO POCKET, a handheld console which also received a Good Design Award that same year. Its updated sister the NEOGEO POCKET COLOR was released in 1999, and as you can guess, featured colored sprites.
L126: Though software for the NEOGEO AES discontinued in 2004, in 2018, SNK celebrated its 40^{th} anniversary by releasing the NEOGEO mini—a pocket-sized mini console which allowed fans to enjoy classic NEOGEO titles on their modern TVs and even on-the-go. Even today, the NEOGEO brand is adored by many fans all across the globe.
